summary: Frontend-only verification of the FIX: Maid subscription checkout now routes through the normal cart_quote engine so government GST and visiting/service charges show ON TOP of the plan price. All 6 review scenarios PASS. (1) Login OTP +919000000004 / 123456 works. (2) /service/svc-maid-fulltime → selected Weekly plan → sub-subscribe-btn navigates to /book. (3) Step 1 Services: sub-recurring-header shows 'Recurring Subscription' badge + 'Full-time Maid' + 'Weekly plan · 6 working days · 7-day period · Sat off' + ₹2,200. (4) Step 2 Schedule: SchedulePicker only (no when-schedule / no when-emergency), default date+slot preselected, next enabled. (5) Step 3 Your Info: existing saved address (Home · 12 MG Road) auto-selected, next enabled. (6) Step 4 Summary — CRITICAL PASS: Price details show Services ₹2,200, Taxable amount ₹2,530 (plan + visiting/service charges layered on TOP), data-testid=checkout-gst renders 'Est. Govt. Taxes ₹455.4' (18% of taxable), and Total payable = ₹2,985.4 which is > ₹2,596 threshold specified in review and clearly > bare plan ₹2,200. Right-side 'Your order' box independently shows the same lines (Taxable ₹2,530, Est. Govt. Taxes ₹455.4, Total ₹2,985.4). (7) Step 5 Confirm: same checkout-gst testid renders '₹455.4', Payment summary lists Services ₹2,200 + Taxable ₹2,530 + Est. Govt. Taxes ₹455.4 + Total payable ₹2,985.4. Clicking data-testid=place-order (Confirm & Pay) triggers POST /subscriptions which returns 409 (customer already has active sub from prior iterations) — placeSubscription's try/catch swallows it and page remains fully rendered (no crash, Confirm & Pay button still visible). Per review spec, reaching the pay action without a crash = PASS. (8) Regression on normal service was validated in iteration_163 through the same /bookings/cart-quote path — same GST engine is now applied to subs, so both flows share the code path.

minor.issue: Returns 409 when the customer already has an active/pending subscription for the same plan. Frontend catches this gracefully; consider a targeted 'You already have this subscription' toast copy. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix landed cleanly: Checkout.jsx toReqItem() now emits a custom line with custom_price=plan_price for subscription cart lines, so /bookings/cart-quote returns base 2200 + gst 396 + visiting/service surcharges (env produced taxable 2530 → gst 455.4 → total 2985.4). Flat plan pricing bug is gone.
checkout-gst / checkout-taxable / place-order data-testids are consistently present on both Summary and Confirm steps and inside the right-side 'Your order' rail — good for automation.

place-order flow surfaces server errors via toast (verified: 409 caught, page not crashed) but no visible toast was captured at 6s (may auto-dismiss). Consider extending toast duration to 5s+ or using data-testid='toast' for easier assertion in future.
Checkout.jsx remains ~1000+ lines — earlier feedback about splitting Step* components still applies for maintainability.
